TotalPortfolioValue.name: Total Portfolio Value
TotalPortfolioValue.definition: Total value of the portfolio. It is derived from the sum of the values of the asset holdings, of the unrealised gain/loss and of the liabilities.

TotalBookValue.name: Total Book Value
TotalBookValue.definition: Net asset on balance sheet - total portfolio value minus or plus the unrealised gain or loss.

TotalReceipts.name: Total Receipts
TotalReceipts.definition: Total receipts attributable to the portfolio.

TotalDisbursements.name: Total Disbursements
TotalDisbursements.definition: Total disbursements attributable to the portfolio.

Portfolio.name: Portfolio
Portfolio.definition: Specifies the portfolio for which a valuation is calculated.

ValuationPeriod.name: Valuation Period
ValuationPeriod.definition: Period for which the valuation is calculated.
